audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly names 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' as Hwei's threat ability. That ability does not exist — Hwei's kit is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. The brief's own defects list flags this: the matchup 'never names any of Hwei's abilities.'
audit.why: All of Hwei's hard CC (his stun/root forms) live on E's kit, Subject: Torment — matching what the prose actually describes ('all his CC lives on E'). The fabricated name is a placeholder that was never replaced with the real ability.
audit.corrected: Replaced every occurrence with 'Subject: Torment (E)' in the fields edited below.

audit.why: Hwei's ranged Q pool out-ranges Thresh's hook at level 1, then the lane evens as Flay lets Thresh interrupt or punish Hwei's channels. Content layer (win[]/whys[]) already reflects this and full-layer phases[].side ('Skill' throughout) agrees since only level 1 favors Hwei and the packet chart confirms it.
Level 2 Flay-interrupt on Hwei's channel, level 6 Box walling off the disengage line (not the E-blink itself), first item enabling Hook-Flay through his slows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named the (fabricated) threat ability as matchup-defining but carried no cooldown number.
audit.why: Subject: Torment (E) is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s by rank — the number is what tells the reader the actual window length.
audit.corrected: Added the real cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns alongside the ability-name fix.
